thread_member_one_member_ck.name: thread_member_one_member_ck
thread_member_one_member_ck.value:
("thread_member"."member_type" = 'user' and "thread_member"."user_id" is not null and "thread_member"."agent_id" is null)
       or ("thread_member"."member_type" = 'agent' and "thread_member"."agent_id" is not null and "thread_member"."user_id" is null)

memory_scope_owner_ck.name: memory_scope_owner_ck
memory_scope_owner_ck.value:
("memory"."scope" = 'workspace' and "memory"."agent_id" is null and "memory"."user_id" is null)
       or ("memory"."scope" = 'agent' and "memory"."agent_id" is not null and "memory"."user_id" is null)
       or ("memory"."scope" = 'agent_user' and "memory"."agent_id" is not null and "memory"."user_id" is not null)

connection_credentials_ck.name: connection_credentials_ck
connection_credentials_ck.value:
("connection"."credentials_ciphertext" is null) = ("connection"."key_ciphertext" is null)
        and ("connection"."credentials_ciphertext" is null) = ("connection"."key_id" is null)

mcp_server_client_ck.name: mcp_server_client_ck
mcp_server_client_ck.value:
("mcp_server"."client_ciphertext" is null) = ("mcp_server"."client_key_ciphertext" is null)
        and ("mcp_server"."client_ciphertext" is null) = ("mcp_server"."client_key_id" is null)
